entities.summary: George Oates is an Australian-born designer and entrepreneur, best known for being the first designer of the photo-sharing website Flickr and for creating the Flickr Commons program. Since 2007 she has worked in the cultural heritage sector and is regarded as "increasingly a go-to expert on digital archives". She has also written a book called If Only The Grimms Had Known Alice, a retelling of the Grimm brothers' fairy tales to include female characters.
